d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ke bich rashtriy janta dal (RJD) pramukh lalu prasad yadav ki beti rohini aachary ke ek bayan ne bihar ke rajnitik galiyaron men halchal barha di hai. midiya se batchit men rohini aachary ne mukhyamantri nitish kumar ko apna 'chacha' batate hue kaha ki ve chhath puja ke dauran kharna ka prasad khane unke ghar jarur jaengi.
Vipaksh ke davon ke bich bayan ke nikale ja rahe siyasi mayne
